artifact.name: notify_inactive_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
  -- List customers in the segment
  local list_res = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
  if not list_res.ok then
    return { error = list_res.error, message = list_res.message }
  end

  local notified: { string } = {}
  local failed: { string } = {}
  local sends: number = 0
  local max_sends: number = 10

  for i, cust in list_res.customers do
    if cust.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
      if sends >= max_sends then
        break
      end
      local text = "Hi " .. cust.name .. ", we miss you!"
      local send_res = tools.message.send({ user = cust.id, text = text })
      if not send_res.ok then
        table.insert(failed, cust.id)
      else
        table.insert(notified, cust.id)
      end
      sends += 1
    end
  end

  return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
artifact.description: List customers in a segment and message those inactive for N days (up to 10 sends).
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you want to re-engage customers in a segment who haven't been seen for a specified number of days.
